concerns.text: Task T020 and T028-T029 implement a Temporal Split and Bootstrap Resampling, directly violating FR-004 (Spatial Split: Eastern/Western US) and FR-006 (Linear Mixed-Effects Model). The tasks silently replace the required validation methodology with an unapproved alternative without a spec amendment.

Task T032 generates a regional map for Lake Powell, violating FR-007 which mandates 'continental-scale maps'. The task scope is narrowed to a local region, failing to deliver the required continental visualization.

Task T024 (Permutation Importance) is marked as incomplete/missing. FR-005 and SC-005 explicitly require permutation importance to verify robustness against collinearity. The absence of this task leaves a critical functional requirement unimplemented.

Task T011 requires downloading the full eBird Basic Dataset (2015–2023) but lacks the specific streaming/sampling logic required to satisfy the 7GB RAM constraint mentioned in the plan and SC-004. Without explicit chunking logic, this task risks violating the memory constraint.
